item.title: SK hynix sets first HBF standard for AI memory
item.summary: SK hynix and Sandisk have unveiled the first standard specification for High Bandwidth Flash (HBF), positioning the technology as a new memory tier for AI infrastructure. Announced at FMS 2026 in Santa Clara, California, the specification follows the launch of an HBF consortium six months ago.
